title: PixelUp: Zero-Shot Semantic Feature Upsampling for Fine-Grained Vision Tasks
mechanism: Zero-shot VFM-agnostic upsampler using a coarse-to-fine chain of windowed cross-attention guided by multi-scale semantic features to avoid texture artifacts of image-guided upsamplers.
adaptation: Third arm of the upsampler probe; semantic guidance should stop copying multi-crystal grain texture into crack features.
min_experiment: Within X1 probe: PixelUp-512 vs AnyUp-512 vs bilinear-1024; CV crack AP and false-positive rate on multi cells. Kill if below AnyUp.
evidence: R: average +1.2 mIoU on semantic segmentation and +0.25 delta1 on NYUv2 over prior upsamplers across VFMs.
